powerlines.source: OpenStreetMap power=line (transmission; distribution lines largely unmapped)

buildings.source: OpenStreetMap building and building:part footprints, height >= 20 m or >= 6 levels

surface.source: FAA ADDS Class airspace, surface areas

class_b.source: FAA ADDS Class B shelves (all floors)

grid.source: US Census 2020 TIGER/Line blocks (POP20) + LEHD LODES8 WAC 2021 (C000 jobs), tiled

landuse.source: OpenStreetMap landuse, leisure, natural and amenity areas, rasterized to 100 m (most specific area wins)

heights.source: USGS 3DEP lidar point clouds (EPT, depth 6), second-highest return above the 3DEP DEM per 50 m cell

traffic.source: OpenSky Network historical ADS-B state vectors (4 Mondays, 40 hours), below 3,000 ft AGL

wind.source: NOAA HRRR 2025 hourly analyses, 10 m and 80 m wind and surface gust, local 07:00-20:00
